entity_raw.definition_raw:
You nimbly dodge beneath your opponent, creating an opportunity to upend your foe.

Prerequisite(s): Int 13, Combat Expertise, Improved Trip, Acrobatics 7 ranks.

Benefit(s): When you succeed at an Acrobatics check to move through an enemy’s space, you can spend a swift action to attempt a trip combat maneuver check against the opponent. Even if you fail this check by 10 or more, you do not fall prone.

Normal: If you fail a trip combat maneuver check by 10 or more, you are knocked prone.
